summary: EchoStar Corporation filed an 8-K reporting the closing of the Spectrum Transfer phase of its license sale to SpaceX (Space Exploration Technologies Corp.) under an amended license purchase agreement. EchoStar subsidiaries transferred spectrum assets (50 MHz in various bands plus up to 15 MHz AWS) to a trust. At this transfer closing, SpaceX reimbursed EchoStar for cash interest payments on seller notes. The second stage (Spectrum Acquisition Closing), where the trust transfers assets to SpaceX and payment of the total consideration occurs, is targeted for November 30, 2027. Key terms like price per share or premium are not detailed in this filing. The transaction has regulatory timelines; watch for FCC approval progress and risk-arb on the 2027 close.
